Google Maps Could Soon Order Your Food While You Drive — Gemini Integration Teased

Quick summary

Hidden code in Google Maps beta 26.27 reveals Gemini-powered food ordering capabilities — the app could soon suggest restaurants, compile orders, and arrange pickup or delivery while you drive, transforming Maps from navigation tool to autonomous agent.

Key takeaways

  • Google Maps beta 26.27.00.941319029 for Android contains code referencing food ordering functionality
  • Feature linked to Ask Maps, the conversational interface powered by Gemini AI
  • Users could describe what they want to eat; Maps suggests nearby restaurants and handles the order
  • Transforms Maps from passive navigation guide to active agent that takes actions on behalf of users
  • Key questions remain: direct restaurant integration vs. delivery partners (Deliveroo, Uber Eats), payment handling, menu accuracy
  • Google has not officially announced the feature; launch timeline unknown
